tiktok.author: imactuallyinsaneguys
tiktok.body:
I’m so sick of subscriptions
What is the point of having subscriptions if you can't watch the movies on the subscriptions I wanted to watch a Hot Fuzz last night okay and I'm looking to see what streaming service it's on cause of course it's gotta be on fuckin one of them and I'm like oh well I have access to this one it says it's on here and I'm like oh cool there it is $15 to buy what okay I'm not paying for the subscription I use someone else's but still this other person is paying for a subscription and and you gotta pay for the movie and then I'm like looking at other ones and it's like oh yeah this one you can have two but you gotta rent it what the what what's the point of the subscription if you gotta pay to rent it anyway I hate that the world is just all fucking subscriptions I miss the days where I could go down to the video store on a Thursday and borrow a movie for a week for $1.
